outcome: Feasibility of implementing FCDTs during surgery for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS)
cohort: 13 patients with PAS undergoing surgical management
finding: Implementation of FCDTs during PAS care is possible in selected patients at centers with experience in managing this disease.
mod_finding: This study investigated the feasibility of family-centered delivery techniques (FCDTs) during surgeries for placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) and found that it was possible in over half of the cases without hindering interdisciplinary management.
